## pytest Plugin

Installing `agentic_hil` registers the `agentic_hil` pytest plugin, so CI regression suites can drive the same permission-gated tools without an MCP client.

The `agentic_hil` fixture uses the same discovered config or absolute-path override as every other entry point and verifies that its `workspace_root` matches the pytest rootdir. Tests using the fixture skip when no config exists and fail loudly when an available config is invalid. Pytest executes project code and is therefore not a sandbox or security boundary; real unattended hardware runners must still use OS isolation and host-managed invocation. COM and CAN sessions opened during a test are stopped afterwards so stimulus state cannot leak between tests.
